finding: Village Guardian completion POST returned HTTP 400 in the accepted WebBridge observation.
disposition: This implementation defect does not invalidate source-truth, non-runnable-route, asset, or bounded browser evidence. It is a mandatory carry-forward disclosure and successor implementation defect, not evidence of successful completion.
required_limits: No candidate or accepted evidence manifest may claim successful completion, persistence, XP award, idempotency, or API correctness.
The accepted manifest must reference the exact browser audit, the HTTP 400, and this direction.
Any successor implementation that claims completion must fix and integration-test the API independently.
All source truth, semantic, denominator, provenance, fresh-review, and lifecycle gates remain required.
supersedes: The prior completion finding's use as an automatic B5 blocker only; it remains a recorded successor defect.
